schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions stay SHA-pinned with a trailing `# vX` comment. config:best-practices already enables pinDigests; grouping keeps one PR per week instead of one per action.
Patch and minor Cargo updates carry little risk individually and are verified by the same CI gate, so batch them.
Cargo majors land alone so the breaking change is reviewable on its own.

zellij-tile owns the plugin's whole transitive graph, the documented minimum Zellij version, and every advisory decision in .cargo/audit.toml. It is never batched, and its PR carries the re-review checklist.
prBodyNotes: ### Required re-review for a zellij-tile bump
- [ ] Run `cargo audit`, then move `.cargo/audit.toml` aside and run it again. Identical output means every entry in `ignore` is dead and must be deleted.
- [ ] Re-measure the graph: `cargo tree -p showy-quota-zellij --target wasm32-wasip1 --edges normal --prefix none | sort -u | wc -l`. Record the new count in the CHANGELOG.
- [ ] Update the minimum Zellij version in `docs/plugin.md`. Zellij guarantees only that a plugin built for an older Zellij runs on a newer server, not the reverse, so the floor tracks this crate.

customManagers.description: cargo-audit is pinned in workflow run steps, which no built-in manager reads.
shellcheck is installed from a pinned GitHub release tarball.
